app.name: AlgoFlow
app.title: {title} — AlgoFlow
app.desktopOnly: AlgoFlow needs a window at least 1280 px wide. Please open it in a desktop browser.

loop.build: Build: add blocks to the chart under Start.
loop.run: Run: watch the chart work on one input, step by step, and compare its output with the expected one.
loop.submit: Submit: check every case; fix the chart until all of them pass.

escape.action: Close a menu or editor and clear the selection; while running, clear the breakpoint, else Stop

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Programs of your own: no problem, no inputs, no Submit. The last one you edited comes first.
playground.importFailed: This file is not an AlgoFlow program, so nothing was added.
playground.empty: No programs yet. New opens an empty one.
playground.deleteText: The program is removed from this browser. This cannot be undone.

modules.title: Modules
modules.stub: Your modules will be listed here.

empty.label: Empty slot
empty.help: A slot that still needs a value.

assign.label: Set variable
assign.help: Creates a variable, or changes the value of one that exists.

if.label: If
if.help: Runs the then region when the condition is true, otherwise the else region.

for.label: For loop
for.help: Counts the variable from start up to, but not including, stop.

while.label: While loop
while.help: Repeats the body as long as the condition stays true.

break.label: Break
break.help: Leaves the innermost loop at once.

continue.label: Continue
continue.help: Skips the rest of the body and starts the next iteration.

print.label: Print
print.help: Writes the values to the Output tab, separated by spaces.

return.label: Return
return.help: Leaves the function and hands back the value.

expr.label: Expression
expr.help: Evaluates an expression for its effect, such as a method call.

num.label: Number
num.help: A whole number or a decimal.

str.label: Text
str.help: A piece of text, typed without quotes. The chart shows it in quotes: "Fizz".

true.label: True
true.help: The value of a check that holds.

false.label: False
false.help: The value of a check that does not hold.

none.label: None
none.help: The value that stands for nothing.

var.label: Variable
var.help: The current value of a variable.

binop.label: Operator
binop.help: Combines two values with arithmetic, a comparison, and/or, or in.

add.label: Add
add.help: Adds two numbers, or joins two texts. Example: 4 + 3 is 7. Type +.

sub.label: Subtract
sub.help: Takes the right number from the left one. Example: 7 − 3 is 4. Type -.

mul.label: Multiply
mul.help: Multiplies two numbers. Example: 4 × 3 is 12. Type *.

div.label: Divide
div.help: Divides the left number by the right one, giving a decimal. Example: 7 ÷ 2 is 3.5. Type /.

mod.label: Remainder
mod.help: What is left when the left number is divided by the right one. Example: the remainder of 7 divided by 3 is 1. Type %.

floorDiv.label: Whole-number quotient
floorDiv.help: How many whole times the right number fits in the left one. Example: the whole-number quotient of 7 divided by 2 is 3. Type //.

pow.label: Power
pow.help: The left number multiplied by itself as many times as the right one says. Example: 2 to the power of 3 is 8. Type **.

eq.label: Equals
eq.help: True when both sides are the same value. Example: 3 = 3 is true. Type ==.

ne.label: Does not equal
ne.help: True when the two sides are different values. Example: 3 ≠ 4 is true. Type !=.

lt.label: Less than
lt.help: True when the left side is smaller. Example: 3 < 4 is true. Type <.

le.label: At most
le.help: True when the left side is smaller or the same. Example: 4 ≤ 4 is true. Type <=.

gt.label: Greater than
gt.help: True when the left side is larger. Example: 4 > 3 is true. Type >.

ge.label: At least
ge.help: True when the left side is larger or the same. Example: 4 ≥ 4 is true. Type >=.

in.label: Is in a list
in.help: True when the value is one of the list's items. Example: 5 is in [4, 9, 5] is true. Type in.

and.label: And
and.help: True when both sides are true. Example: i > 0 and i < 10 is true when i is 5. Type and.

or.label: Or
or.help: True when one side or both sides are true. Example: i = 3 or i = 5 is true when i is 3 and when i is 5. Type or.

join.label: Join with another list
join.help: A new list with the items of the left list, then those of the right one. Example: [1, 2] + [3] is [1, 2, 3]. Type +.

unop.label: Negate
unop.help: Flips the sign of a number or the truth of a value.

not.label: Not
not.help: True when the value after it is false. Example: not (3 > 4) is true. Type not.

call.label: Call function
call.help: Calls one of your functions with the given arguments.

call:abs.label: Absolute value
call:abs.help: The number without its sign. Example: the absolute value of −4 is 4.

call:min.label: Smaller of two
call:min.help: The smaller of two numbers or texts. Example: the smaller of 4 and 9 is 4.

call:max.label: Larger of two
call:max.help: The larger of two numbers or texts. Example: the larger of 4 and 9 is 9.

call:str.label: As text
call:str.help: Turns any value into its text form.

call:int.label: As whole number
call:int.help: Turns a decimal or numeric text into a whole number.

call:float.label: As decimal
call:float.help: Turns a whole number or numeric text into a decimal.

call:random_int.label: Random whole number
call:random_int.help: A random whole number between the two bounds, both included.

run.endless: This run never reached its end: it stopped after 1,000,000 steps. A loop does not seem to end; check its condition.

error.E_UNDEFINED: Variable {name} has not been created yet
error.E_DECLARE_FIRST: Create {name} before the if or loop
error.E_BAD_NAME: Names start with a lowercase letter or _ and use only lowercase letters, digits, and _; Python keywords are not allowed
error.E_BREAK_OUTSIDE: This block only works inside a loop
error.E_RETURN_OUTSIDE: Return only works inside a function
error.E_DEFAULT: The default of {field} must be a number, text, true/false, an empty list, or an empty dict
error.E_DUPLICATE_ID: Two blocks share the same id
error.E_PARSE_CHAIN: Write a < b < c as a < b and b < c
error.E_TYPE: {left} and {right} cannot be used in this operation
error.E_POP_EMPTY: The list is empty, nothing to pop
error.E_RECURSION: Function calls are nested too deeply; check the stopping condition
error.E_STEP_LIMIT: The loop does not seem to end; check its condition
